prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Companion", "Sign in to bind your customized pet to your account and prevent progress resets.", "Use your primary login to access your pet on any device."]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a ready-to-use pet style or create a custom companion.", "Available Pet Styles"]
2: ["Desktop Pet Controls 101", "Drag your pet anywhere, right-click to access shortcuts, or click to chat.", "Quick Controls Overview", "Your Companion is Ready!", "Welcome your new pet to your desktop workspace."]
3: ["Hatching Your Companion...", "We are preparing your desktop pet. Enjoy these quick tips while setup completes.", "Desktop Pet Shortcuts & Tricks"]
4: ["Sign In to Restore & Sync", "Log in with your existing account to instantly restore your adoption history.", "Note: Creating a new login creates a fresh profile with no saved pets."]
5: ["Building Your Desktop World", "Custom pet rendering takes about 60-90 seconds. Please keep the window open.", "Estimated Time Remaining"]
6: ["Select Your Adoption Speed", "Choose a instant preset pet ( ready in 10s ) or create a custom pet from photos.", "Instant presets can be customized later in settings!"]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to officially welcome them home.", "Companion Name"]
8: ["Your Pet is Being Prepared", "Feel free to minimize this window. We'll send a system alert when your pet is ready.", "Desktop Alert Enabled"]
9: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is active! Click and drag them anywhere on your screens.", "Start Playing Now"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal photos from the user.
